rule.trainValidity: committed >= 5 and precision >= 0.95 and tau > grid floor
rule.choose: smallest valid tau, ties to the larger tau
rule.holdoutAcceptance: committed >= 8 and correct >= 8 and precision >= 0.9 and recall > recall(current threshold), with a zero baseline treated as undecidable
rule.onFailure: keep the current threshold, change no code

perKind.reason: hold-out không đủ bằng chứng (committed 6, correct 6, precision 1)

decision.limitation: Sweep phase v5: 40 train and 20 hold-out points per kind. Probability is the only axis that can produce a shippable product verdict; confidence is descriptive in v5 unless separately accepted by a future protocol.
